svg.title: Suriyaprakash Palanisamy, Senior Software Engineer: Gears to Graphs
svg.desc: Blueprint drawing. The name is lettered in by a drafting pen. A meshing involute gear train (mechanical engineering origin) drives a lantern wheel whose pins are graph nodes; an encoder turns the motion into a signal that flows through a node graph ending in FastAPI, AWS EKS/ECS and ML forecasting. A title block lists rev 10+ years and scale 1:50+ microservices.
svg.text: GENERAL ARRANGEMENT · DWG S4C-01 · SHEET 01 OF 12
Backend · Cloud · ML platforms · AI-driven development
